note: Small labelled set for scripts/eval-retrieval.mjs. One synthetic persona (not real data). `relevant` lists the memories a good answer to the query would actually use; an empty list means nothing in the wallet should be shared.

memories.text: My name is Alex and I live in Pune.
I'm a final-year student in medical electronics engineering.
I'm vegetarian and allergic to peanuts.
I prefer concise answers with bullet points.
I'm building a Chrome extension called Memory Wallet using TypeScript and React.
I use Python and PyTorch for ECG signal classification research.
My long-term goal is to start a medical device company.
I play the guitar and practice most evenings.
I'm training for a half marathon in March.
I work part-time as a teaching assistant for a signals and systems course.
I use a Windows laptop with 16 GB of RAM.
I'm learning Japanese and currently studying for JLPT N5.
I have a younger sister who is in high school.
I am applying for master's programs in biomedical engineering this fall.
I prefer dark mode in every app.
I usually write code in VS Code.
My budget for a new phone is around 25,000 rupees.
I'm interested in wearable health devices, especially ECG patches.
I commute to college by metro.
I have a golden retriever called Biscuit.
